result.brief: 提出结合鸟瞰可达性监督与深度重建的导航导向视觉表征预训练方法，冻结编码器后在线性探针、模仿学习与PPO下比较表征目标，并实现零样本仿真到实机迁移。
result.reason: Pretrains frozen depth-based visual encoders with reachability supervision and compares representation objectives across policy learners; representation-learning contribution for embodied navigation.
